Leah: Quick sync  interview with Aurora done this AM. Goal: short customer spotlight blog + transcript + 3 social cuts. Proposed embargo 2026-05-05. Who owns transcript and quote signoff?
Owen: I can run transcription and diarization. Please confirm final audio path.
Leah: Uploaded: s3://redwood-marketing/aurora/audio/aurora_interview_2026-04-01.wav
TranscribeBot: Job accepted  ETA ~90m. Will output diarized TXT and SRT to deliverables folder.
Priya: Ill pick 3 quote options (1 conservative) and email Aurora for signoff. Also will request permission for short clips.
Leah: Need two things from legal: (1) guidance on numeric claims, (2) approval language for using company logo in the post.
Harper (Legal): For metrics, either provide KPI snapshot or use guarded language (e.g., "roughly", "about"). For logos, we need a signed logo use form. I can draft an approval email template. Turnaround ~48h.
LocalizeCo: We have DE/ES slots 05/02-05/03. Need final clean transcript + glossary by 05/01.
TranscribeBot: Transcripts uploaded to s3://redwood-marketing/aurora/deliverables/ at 2026-04-01T11:42:10Z :white_check_mark:
Owen: Diarized transcript has speaker labels (Customer / Host) and timecodes. Ive also marked 00:01:10-00:02:10 and 00:03:20-00:04:00 as candidate social cuts.
Priya: Sent quote options and logo request to Aurora; asked for signoff by 2026-04-04 EOD. Will escalate if no reply.
Leah: Nice. Next steps: Owen finalize assets + social cuts; Priya chase signoff; Harper prepare logo template + metric wording. Lock embargo once signoff + legal ok. Will post launch brief when ready. :sparkles:
